supersedes: g2-criteria.json (v1, preserved unchanged — never edited in place)
supersession_reason: v1 defined the G2-A population as every cell with a non-null icc_ri (1,638 over five origins) but wrote its pass rule against four origins. G2-A's statistic uses only ICC and excess return and needs no momentum, so it runs on all five. The four-origin denominator was carried over from G2-B and G2-C by inattention. Caught by the worker before any result existed, under the stop-and-ask rule.

amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.population: all cells with non-null icc_ri: 1,638 over origins 2019-2023
amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.why_five_origins_are_valid_here: T_t is built from ICC and EXC only. Momentum enters neither the statistic nor the stratification, so the 2019 momentum gap does not bind G2-A.
amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.v1_rule: observed T_t significant at p <= 0.05 in at least 3 of 4 origins, for each of the B/P and size stratifications
amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.v2_rule: observed T_t significant at p <= 0.05 in at least 4 of 5 origins, for each of the B/P and size stratifications
amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.tolerance_is_unchanged_in_intent: v1 allowed one origin to fail out of four. v2 allows one out of five. Expressed as a fraction the bar rises from 0.75 to 0.80; the stricter reading was chosen deliberately, before any T_t was computed, so that fixing my own error cannot be a loosening.
amendment_1_G2A_population_and_denominat.G2_B_and_G2_C_denominators_unchanged: G2-B remains PRE12 on 2020-2023 and PRE24 on 2021-2023; G2-C remains the 1,324-cell momentum sample. Those sub-gates genuinely require the lookback windows.

amendment_2_rng_mapping_confirmed.requirement: the artifact records the generator and the seed actually used for every (origin, stratification) pair, and a rerun must reproduce every p-value exactly

carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.G2_A_statistic_T_t: unchanged — half-split on ICC within stratum, difference of mean EXC, count-weighted over strata with n_g >= 4
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.G2_A_stratifications: unchanged — S_bp, S_size, S_sec run separately, never crossed; S_sec requires groups of at least 6 and reports excluded cells; S_sec enters no threshold
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.G2_B: unchanged in specification, samples, reported quantities and the fixed interpretation rule (|t| < 2 or partial R-squared < 0.01 is not leakage)
carried_forward_verbatim_from_v1.G2_C: unchanged — permute price within origin, re-solve ICC, every other regressor keeps its true value, 200 reps, 5% non-convergence stop

verdict_rules.G2_PASS: ALL of: (a) G2-A observed T_t significant at p <= 0.05 in at least 4 of 5 origins for the B/P stratification AND at least 4 of 5 for the size stratification; (b) G2-B shows no leakage signal by the fixed interpretation rule, on both PRE12 and PRE24; (c) G2-C places the observed coefficient above the 97.5th percentile of the placebo distribution.
verdict_rules.G2_LEAKAGE_OR_MECHANICAL_ARTIFACT: ANY of: G2-B shows a leakage signal; G2-C places the observed coefficient inside the central 95% of the placebo distribution; G2-A fails in both the B/P and size stratifications.
verdict_rules.G2_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including a split between the B/P and size stratifications, or a stop condition in G2-C
